node.statement: Neumann inversion and range transport: the inequality ||W-I||<1 makes W invertible by the convergent Neumann series. From WE=FW, W sends Ran(E) into Ran(F), and E W^{-1}=W^{-1}F. Thus for y in Ran(F), x=W^{-1}y obeys Ex=x and Wx=y; consequently W restricts to a linear bijection Ran(E)->Ran(F), proving equality of their dimensions.
